Every integration is native. Once connected, Allo matches each call to the right contact or deal, then writes the call, AI summary and next steps back automatically, with no manual logging.
Do I have to build anything myself?
No. Most integrations connect in a few clicks from your Allo settings. For anything custom, our webhook plus Zapier and Make support lets you wire Allo into the rest of your stack.
My tool isn't listed. Can you add it?
Yes. We build integrations in-house and ship new ones regularly. Tell sales which tool you need and we'll tell you where it sits on the roadmap.
Is there an extra cost for integrations?
No. Integrations are included in your plan. You connect the tools you use and your CRM stays in sync at no extra charge.
